measurementPriority: Capture BOOTH sales by product/date before declaring a paid winner.
Capture note sales/PV/likes by article before amplifying a note series.
Capture Microsoft Store page views, install attempts, acquisitions, installs, first launches and conversion by source/campaign before creating app derivatives.
Add measurable campaign/referral identifiers from free tools to verified paid/Store destinations when possible.

rules: At 13:10, service carried debt first but do not spend another full cycle on the same blocked item after the 07:10 and 10:10 failures.
Prepare at least two publishable fallbacks per channel before the local publication attempt begins.
If the active candidate cannot reach strict buyer/reader-visible verification quickly, defer it and switch in the same run.
Maintain more qualified candidates than the remaining hard minimum so one blocked item never stalls the day.
Queue insertion, local success, admin/editor URLs and commits do not count as publication.
Do not publish near-duplicate low-value products merely to satisfy count; use a distinct qualified fallback.
Do not require Windows execution after 01:00 JST; cloud preparation continues and debt remains intact.
Do not label a product or cluster a winner without observed performance evidence.
